shots.note: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); const l = Object.values(hillinkWorld.theme.layout.lifts)[0]; return 'claude gait ' + e.gait + ', lift ' + l.id + ' floors ' + l.floors.join(','); })()

shots.name: E03b-builder-route-enters-site-through-its-door
shots.expect: (() => { const n = (() => { const L = hillinkWorld.theme.layout, s = L.locationById['site:meeting-room'], r = L.route(L.locationById.queue.door, s.id, Object.values(s.stations)[0]); return r ? r.map(p => p.at?.node ?? 'point') : null; })(); return Array.isArray(n) && n.some(x => String(x).startsWith('sitegate:')) && !n.includes('room-4~in~door-5'); })()
shots.note: 'route lobby -> site: ' + ((() => { const L = hillinkWorld.theme.layout, s = L.locationById['site:meeting-room'], r = L.route(L.locationById.queue.door, s.id, Object.values(s.stations)[0]); return r ? r.map(p => p.at?.node ?? 'point') : null; })() ?? ['UNREACHABLE']).filter(x => /door|sitegate|site:/.test(x)).join(' > ')
